notes.title: Update 1.0
notes.content:
Patch notes
Fixes in this update include the following.
-Head shots not killing zombies instantly.
-Frame rate Drops.
-Shortend long loading times for levels.
-Graphical errors.
-increased the Field of view (FOV).
